messages:
olivia: Hypothetical lunch topic: if LLMs had job titles at a career fair, what would they put on their name tags? Drop one-liners. :bento:

pranav: 'GPT-4.0 — Senior Context Manager, specializes in last-minute spec changes.' :briefcase: :joy:

tess: 'TinyQuant — Junior Memory Saver, refuses to forget anything smaller than 8 bits.' :chipmunk: :floppy_disk:

olivia: 'Reranker-Rita — Head of Opinions, will politely rank your feelings.' :sparkles:

pranav: "Interview question: 'Tell me about a time you handled ambiguous requirements.' Reranker-Rita: 'Ranked them.'" :laughing:

ops-bot: Poll created  React :one: Context Manager :two: Memory Saver :three: Head of Opinions. Poll ends in 12h.

tess: my pitch for a swag sticker: TinyQuant with a cape that reads "I pack a punch in 8 bits." :sparkling_heart:

olivia: bonus: company picnic idea  'Model Speed Dating' booth where each model explains its favorite prompt style in 30s. 

pranav: someone should make a LinkedIn mock: 'Reranker-Rita 3 Director, Prioritization — increased user satisfaction by 17% by reordering replies.' :trophy:

tess: last line: if a model lists "hobbies: pruning, warm restarts" I'm hiring. :grin:

olivia: tagging this for the weekly meme roundup. low-effort, high-quality. :thumbsup:
